title: Extension of open morphisms from a finite depth-two source
statement: Let $L$ be a locally Noetherian scheme and $U\subset L$ an open [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions, def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring]. Let $r:F\to L$ be finite and $p:E\to L$ affine [def-weil-finite-integral-morphism, def-weil-affine-morphism]. Assume $\operatorname{depth}\mathcal O_{F,z}\geq2$ for every $z$ with $r(z)\notin U$ [def-weil-pbc-depth]. Let $a:F\times_L U\to E\times_L U$ be a morphism over $U$. There is an $L$-morphism $f:F\to E$ satisfying $\iota_F f=a\iota_E$, where $\iota_F$ and $\iota_E$ are the inclusions of these open subschemes.

source.place: Tag 0EY6, converse in the proof of (2); Tags 0AUK, 0E9I and 01SA

proof.text: The coherent finite structure algebra r_*O_F has boundary stalk depth at least two: on an affine chart localize the finite algebra at the base point and apply the finite-local-algebra depth formula of Stacks Tag 0AUK to the source local rings above it. The empty fibre gives the zero module, of infinite depth. Hartogs then makes the canonical map r_*O_F -> j_*((r_*O_F)|_U) invertible. This restriction map preserves products and scalars, so its inverse also preserves them.

The given open morphism induces an algebra map (p_*O_E)|_U -> (r_*O_F)|_U. Adjunction and the inverse Hartogs map extend it to p_*O_E -> r_*O_F. The affine-target structure algebra correspondence supplies f over L. Restricting this algebra map gives the original map by the adjunction identities, hence faithfulness over U gives the required restriction equality.

theorem exists_hom_of_finite_depth_two
    {L : Scheme.{u}} [IsLocallyNoetherian L] (U : L.Opens)
    {F E : Scheme.{u}} (r : F ⟶ L) (p : E ⟶ L) [IsFinite r] [IsAffineHom p]
    (hF : ∀ z : F, r z ∉ U →
      (2 : ℕ∞) ≤ IsLocalRing.depth (R := F.presheaf.stalk z) (F.presheaf.stalk z))
    (a : (r ⁻¹ᵁ U).toScheme ⟶ (p ⁻¹ᵁ U).toScheme)
    (ha : a ≫ p ∣_ U = r ∣_ U) :
    ∃ f : F ⟶ E, f ≫ p = r ∧ (r ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι ≫ f = a ≫ (p ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι
